calls.summary: Marcus Delgado called the Plano shop to book a full-synthetic oil change and asked about the courtesy inspection. Agent Oscar confirmed same-week availability, explained the digital vehicle inspection with photos, and scheduled his service appointment. Marcus left happy and mentioned he would use the free shuttle to get to work.

Priya Nair asked for a quote on front brake pads and rotors for her Honda CR-V. Agent Lila explained the free brake inspection and the 3 year, 36,000 mile warranty, then booked her service appointment for Thursday. Priya appreciated the transparent pricing and confirmed the drop-off time.

David Osei had a check engine light on his F-150 and wanted a computer diagnostic. Agent Rosey walked him through the process and scheduled a service appointment for the next morning. She noted the shuttle option and David booked without hesitation.

New customer Elena Marroquin called to set up her first visit after moving to the area and asked for an oil change plus a general checkup. Agent Mary collected her name, phone number, vehicle year and make, and preferred drop-off time, then explained the shuttle service and booked her service appointment. Elena said the Nice Difference reputation is why she chose the shop.

Trent Bishop noticed his car pulling to the right and asked about a wheel alignment. Agent Lee explained the camber and toe adjustment and quoted a typical range, then scheduled an alignment service appointment. Trent confirmed and asked for a reminder text.

Sofia Reyes said her AC was not blowing cold and wanted it looked at before summer. Agent Sue described the refrigerant recharge and leak check and booked an AC service appointment. Sofia was satisfied and asked about the shuttle for the drop-off.

Howard Kline called to confirm coverage on a recent repair under the 3 year, 36,000 mile warranty. Agent Mike verified the invoice and reassured him the part was covered, but no new work was scheduled. Howard was reassured about the warranty terms.

Gina Fowler checked on the status of a special-order part for her oil change and filter service that had been delayed. Agent Jennifer looked up the ticket and said the part would arrive in 24-48h and would call back. Gina was mildly frustrated by the wait but agreed to hold.

Ray Coleman asked whether the free shuttle service could pick him up from home rather than just drop off. Agent Rose explained the shuttle radius and could not guarantee home pickup that day. Ray did not schedule and said he would think it over.

Bethany Cross disputed a charge on her brake service invoice, saying she expected a lower quote. Agent Oscar reviewed the digital inspection line items and offered to have the advisor call her back. Bethany remained unhappy and no resolution was reached on the call.

Naomi Pruitt called about a dead battery and wanted a battery replacement quote. Agent Lila explained the load test and terminal cleaning and booked a service appointment despite some line noise. Naomi confirmed the time after a short misunderstanding.

Victor Aldridge complained that his transmission still slipped after a recent service. Agent Lee apologized and tried to schedule a re-inspection, but Victor grew impatient and demanded a manager. The call ended without a firm booking.

Carla Monroe followed up on a warranty repair for a check engine light issue that recurred after pickup. Agent Sue struggled to locate the prior ticket and put her on a long hold. Carla left annoyed and no appointment was set.

Dwight Sanderson called to cancel an existing service appointment because he found another shop. Agent Mike processed the cancellation and asked for feedback, but Dwight declined to elaborate. The call closed on a cool note.
Angela Booth called after hours about an oil change price and reached voicemail. No agent was available and the message was logged for a callback. No appointment was scheduled during this call.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Christian Brothers Automotive in Maple Grove. This is Marcus speaking. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, yes, I need to schedule a brake service appointment. I think my brake pads are getting worn and I want to get them checked out.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great, I can definitely help you with that. We provide honest, transparent brake service here. May I have your name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure, it is Jennifer Walsh.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, Jennifer. I have you down for brake service. Just to confirm, you are looking at brake pad replacement and a full brake inspection, correct?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. I want to make sure everything is safe before I drive up north next week.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, we can get that done for you. Just to confirm, you are in the Maple Grove area, correct? That is our current location.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, I live just off Highway 169. That location works perfectly for me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent. And what is the best phone number to reach you at for appointment reminders and confirmation?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you. I have that on file. Now let me find you an available time slot. We have openings tomorrow at 10 a.m. or Thursday morning at 9 a.m. Which would work better for you?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thursday at 9 a.m. works great. That gives me more time to prepare.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I have you scheduled for Thursday, October 24th at 9 a.m. for brake service. Just so you know, we offer a free courtesy shuttle service if you need a ride back home while we work on your vehicle.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Oh, that is really helpful. I might take you up on that. How long does the brake service usually take?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Typically, a complete brake inspection and pad replacement takes about one to two hours, depending on what we find. We will call you if anything else comes up. Sound good?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sounds good to me. Thanks, Marcus.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome, Jennifer. Thank you for choosing Christian Brothers Automotive. We will see you Thursday at 9 a.m. Have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Jennifer Walsh called to schedule a brake service appointment at the Maple Grove location due to worn brake pads before an upcoming road trip. Marcus captured her name, confirmed the service need, verified the location, and booked her for Thursday at 9 a.m., also mentioning the free courtesy shuttle service. While the agent successfully scheduled the appointment and maintained a professional tone, he did not capture the customer's email address for confirmation or gather vehicle details such as year, make, and model to better scope the brake work. The call demonstrates solid appointment-booking fundamentals but missed opportunities to build customer context and set detailed service expectations.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus, nice work structuring the intake and getting Jennifer booked for Thursday morning. You confirmed the service need clearly and offered the shuttle service as a value add. Two quick coaching points for next time. First, capture the email address so Jennifer receives a written confirmation and details about our digital vehicle inspection report. Second, ask for the vehicle year and make so our technicians have context before she arrives. These details help us set expectations about what the inspection will cover and what the customer should expect when she arrives. Great phone manner overall.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, my check engine light came on this morning and the car feels like it's shaking a little at stops. I've never been in before.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry to hear that, we can definitely take a look. Can I start with your name?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure, it's Danielle Foster.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks Danielle. And what year and make are we working with?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It's a 2018 Honda Accord. The shaking is new, but the light just popped up today.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Got it. We'd run a computer diagnostic first, that pulls the codes so we know exactly what's going on before anyone touches a thing. Then we send you a digital inspection report with photos.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, but what does that run? I want to keep this manageable, money's a little tight right now.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Completely fair. The diagnostic is typically around $110, and if you approve repairs with us that fee goes toward the work. You'll see every recommendation with pricing before you okay anything.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Alright. Honestly I was going to swing by that quick-lube place down the street, they said they'd just read the code for free.

transcript.text: They can read a code, but a free code read won't tell you why the light is on or why it's shaking. Our ASE-certified technicians diagnose the actual cause, and all our work is backed by a 3-year, 36,000-mile warranty.

transcript.text: That warranty is reassuring. While it's in, could you also check the brakes? I hear a squeak when I stop.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, we'll include a courtesy brake inspection at no charge along with the diagnostic. If the pads or rotors need attention it'll all be on that same report.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Perfect. I'd need to be at work by nine though, so drop-off has to be early.

transcript.text: No problem, we open at seven and offer a free shuttle to get you to work while we diagnose it. Can I get you in this Thursday morning?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thursday works. Let's do it.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great, I've got you booked Thursday at 7:15 AM for the diagnostic and courtesy brake inspection. What's the best cell for your inspection report?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're all set, Danielle. Thanks for choosing Christian Brothers Automotive, we'll see you Thursday and take good care of you.
highlights: Thanks for choosing Christian Brothers Automotive

qaPairs.question: How much does an oil change cost?
qaPairs.answer: Pricing depends on your vehicle and the oil type, but most oil and filter changes fall in a typical range and include a courtesy inspection. I can book you a service appointment so a service advisor confirms the exact quote.

qaPairs.question: Do you work on European vehicles?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, our ASE-certified technicians service European makes and use the same equipment the manufacturers use. Let's schedule a service appointment at your nearest shop.

qaPairs.question: My check engine light is on, what should I do?
qaPairs.answer: We can run a computer diagnostic to identify the issue and recommend next steps. I'd be glad to book a service appointment so a technician can take a look.

qaPairs.question: How long does a brake service take?
qaPairs.answer: It varies by vehicle and the parts needed, and after a digital vehicle inspection your service advisor will confirm the timing. Would you like me to schedule a service appointment?

qaPairs.question: Do you offer a warranty on your work?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, qualifying repairs are backed by our Nice Difference warranty of 3 years or 36,000 miles, whichever is longer. I can set up a service appointment whenever you're ready.

qaPairs.question: Can I get a shuttle ride while my car is being serviced?
qaPairs.answer: Many of our locations offer a free shuttle to drop you off or pick you up. Let's book your service appointment and confirm shuttle availability at that shop.

qaPairs.question: How much is a brake job?
qaPairs.answer: Brake service pricing depends on your vehicle and whether pads, rotors or drums are needed, so a service advisor will confirm after inspection. I can schedule a service appointment for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you do wheel alignments?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we adjust camber, caster and toe angles to reduce tire wear and steering pull. I'd be happy to book a service appointment for an alignment.

qaPairs.question: My AC isn't blowing cold, can you fix it?
qaPairs.answer: We handle refrigerant recharge, leak checks and compressor diagnostics for AC systems. Let's schedule a service appointment so a technician can diagnose it.

qaPairs.question: What is a digital vehicle inspection?
qaPairs.answer: After you drop off, our technicians send you a report with pictures and videos so you can review and approve recommended work. I can book your service appointment to get started.

qaPairs.question: How much for a battery replacement?
qaPairs.answer: Battery pricing varies by vehicle and battery type, and we test the charging system before replacing it. Let me set up a service appointment for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you offer any current specials?
qaPairs.answer: Many of our shops run local special offers, and right now a courtesy inspection is included with an oil change. Would you like me to schedule a service appointment?

qaPairs.question: How often should I get scheduled maintenance?
qaPairs.answer: We follow OEM intervals such as 30,000, 60,000 and 90,000 mile services to keep your vehicle in top shape. I can book a service appointment to review your maintenance schedule.

qaPairs.question: Can you do a pre-purchase inspection?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we offer a courtesy pre-purchase inspection to give you a clear picture before you buy. Let's schedule a service appointment at your local shop.

qaPairs.question: Do you service fleet vehicles?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, we provide diagnostics and maintenance for commercial vehicle fleets. I'd be glad to book a service appointment to discuss your fleet needs.

qaPairs.question: How much does a transmission service cost?
qaPairs.answer: Transmission service ranges widely depending on whether it's a fluid exchange or a repair, so a service advisor will confirm after inspection. I can schedule a service appointment for you.

qaPairs.question: What is Care+?
qaPairs.answer: Care+ is our membership offering that adds value to your regular service and maintenance. Let's book a service appointment and I can have an advisor share the details.

qaPairs.question: Do I need an appointment or can I just walk in?
qaPairs.answer: We recommend scheduling so we can plan for your vehicle and reduce your wait. I can book a service appointment for you right now.

qaPairs.question: Do you resurface rotors or replace them?
qaPairs.answer: Our brake service includes rotor and drum resurfacing or replacement, along with pads, shoes and hydraulic repairs. Let's schedule a service appointment for a full inspection.

qaPairs.question: Where is my nearest location?
qaPairs.answer: We have over 310 shops nationwide, so if you share your ZIP code I'll find the closest one. Then I can book your service appointment there.
